order_evidence: TotalCycles = column 4: the only counter whose rate stays between 2 and 5.5 G/s with <6% spread across all 54 workloads (memory chains and SIMD alike); a clock is workload-independent.

InstructionRetired = column 0: largest non-clock count per L1-resident load, and per-element counts for each SIMD build are size-independent (within 10% between N=1,024 and N=16,777,216) because the same loop body executes.

LabL1DTLBMiss = column 2: the 4 MiB chain touches 1,024 pages, more than the 64-entry L1 DTLB but fewer than the 2,048-entry L2 DTLB and with data resident in the 16 MiB L3, so it is the only remaining counter that is high there.

LabL2DTLBMiss = column 3: high for the scattered chain (16,384 pages, beyond the 8 MiB L2 DTLB reach) and near zero for the 4 MiB chain; it never exceeds column 2 in any memory run, as required because unit mask 0xF0 is a subset of 0xFF.

LabDemandDRAMFill = column 1: about one event per load for the 64 MiB chain, but low for the scattered chain, whose 1 MiB of touched lines fits in cache even though its pages do not fit the TLB, and near zero in L1.
scope: CPU0 context-switch intervals of the exact benchmark thread inside its QPC timing window
